item.description:
Monopoly Junior KOSMOS board game is a fascinating journey into the unknown, taking young players straight into outer space. Rockets, shimmering asteroids, mysterious planets, and orbital stations await to be discovered. This cosmic edition of the classic game stimulates imagination, teaches strategic thinking, and guarantees great fun for the whole family. Key features of the game:
Adventurous journey between planets – traverse galaxies, collect minerals, and visit distant corners of space. New challenges and cosmic events – space storms, rocket malfunctions, and unpredictable occurrences add excitement to every game. Kid-friendly rules – simplified mechanics allow children to quickly grasp the rules and start playing. Interactive, educational fun – children learn planning, counting, and decision-making while exploring space-related topics. Attractive design and colorful board – futuristic spaces, shiny graphics, and a unique atmosphere encourage long gameplay sessions. For 2–4 players – an ideal family game that engages both children and adults.
Rules of the KOSMOS edition:
Choose an astronaut or helper robot token, take MONOPOLY money, and prepare for launch. A dice roll decides the first player. Landing on planet and space station spaces allows you to purchase them, and if they belong to another player, you pay a fee for stopping there. Acquire all spaces of one color, place a token, and increase your cosmic earnings. The winner is the player who gains dominance on the board and drives opponents to bankruptcy. Once you've mastered the basics, try additional rules to create even more exciting gameplay!

item.description:
This appears to be one of several unlicensed themed versions of Monopoly Junior originating in China. Although Uncle Pennybags appears on the Monopoly Junior logo and (incongruously) on some game spaces and cards, there are no publisher logos or other crediting.
It seems there exist at least five cover variations: two with the Bakugan logo under the Monopoly logo ringed by characters, one of them with a flat Monopoly logo and one with a more elaborate fake-3D one; one with the Bakugan logo in the bottom left and three foreground characters; and two with the Bakugan logo at the bottom flanked by two foreground characters, one with English text and one with a Romanian flag and text.
The gameplay is identical to regular Monopoly Junior, with a nearly complete lack of player decisions. Players roll and move along the board, automatically purchasing visited properties, drawing chance cards, and performing monetary transactions until someone runs out of money. Properties are a selection of characters and other features from the Bakugan franchise.
